entries.category: Chronicles of a New Era - Omega

entries.en:
With Biggs and Wedge not expected to report back for some time, Cid proposes that you move ahead with the tests. Your next opponent, Delta III, is apparently a being known as Halicarnassus, which Nero reveals to be the antagonist from a tale dating back to the Fourth Astral Era. Hearing this, Cid expresses surprise at the thought that Omega is deriving its subjects from works of fiction, at which moment Midgardsormr manifests to provide some timely insight. Omega, the Father of Dragons explains, has no soul and is therefore incapable of imagination; be it from fact or fiction, it must draw upon historic material in order to create. While the revelation excites Nero, it gives Cid a moment's pause, but he sets his questions aside in favor of focusing on the task at hand: defeating Halicarnassus. As has now become traditional, Alpha is waiting patiently for your signal to proceed.

※In the event that you leave the Interdimensional Rift, you may re-enter by speaking with the Ironworks hand at the Yawn.

In the tale, she is one of the chief antagonists, and as such things are wont to unfold, she meets her end at the hands of the heroes─incurably valiant youths not unlike our adventurer friend here.

entries.en: Literary historians have speculated that the tale could be loosely based on events which took place in the Fourth Astral Era, but little remains of that age, and there is no way to verify the claim. Indeed, most now assume the story to be a work of pure fiction.
entries.fr: L'auteur de cette fable clamait l'avoir écrite en s'inspirant d'événements survenus lors de la 4e ère astrale, mais il n'existe pas d'archives permettant de vérifier ses dires. De nos jours, on la considère généralement comme une œuvre de fiction.

作者が自称してるが……あれは「忘れられた時代」だからな。
真偽はわからず、今じゃ創作とするのが一般的だ。

entries.en: Mark me, then. Omega hath no soul. No mind's eye in which to envision a rival.
entries.fr: Oméga n'a pas d'âme. De ce fait, elle n'est pas douée d'imagination, et il lui est impossible d'inventer une entité qui lui servira de rival.
entries.ja:
よいか……オメガめには、心がない。
ゆえに、想像を広げることができない。
己に匹敵する新たな生命体など、自力で描けはせぬのだ。

entries.en: To bring forth new life, it must needs draw upon that which hath already been─its every creation being another's conception.
entries.fr: Pour créer quelque chose, elle est obligée de s'inspirer de la réalité. Je peux vous assurer que tous ses sujets de test ont existé sous une certaine forme, à une certaine époque.
entries.ja:
ゆえに、すでに在るものから、標的を探そうとする……。
造られた被検者たちは皆、何らかの形で、
いつかどこかに在った者であろうよ。

entries.en: This limitation is concealed by the breadth of its experience. It possesseth the means to retain the knowledge of entire eras─and not only of this reflection. Yet it perceiveth not this knowledge as we do.
entries.fr: Oméga est capable d'assimiler des millénaires de savoir grâce à ses pouvoirs, mais elle ne perçoit pas cette con<->nais<->san<->ce de la même façon que nous.
entries.ja:
……ただし、汝らと奴とでは、視点がまるで違う。
あの性能をもってすれば、この世界の数千年におよぶ歴史も、
重なりあう鏡像世界の出来事でさえ、把握できるであろう。

entries.en: Fact...fiction...the distinction holdeth no meaning for Omega. All is equal in its eyes. If a thing is logical, it can be created.
entries.fr: Pour elle, il n'existe pas de distinction entre la vérité et la fiction. Toutes les choses ont une valeur égale à ses yeux, et ce qui est conforme à sa logique peut être créé.

すべては等しく、生命の言動が織りなす事例にすぎぬ。
奴の理屈で正当とみなされれば、なんであれ再現されよう。

entries.en: So that was Halicarnassus. I must congratulate Omega on her appearance. She looked exactly as I imagined her.
entries.fr: Voilà donc à quoi ressemblait Halicarnasse... Je dois avouer que la création d'Oméga était assez fidèle à la description qui en était faite dans la fable.
entries.ja:

いや、小説に書かれている特徴は、実によく押さえてるぜ？

entries.en: Forgive me. You deserve better than that. Thanks to you, we are but one victory away from clearing the Deltascape. Take as much rest as you need, old friend. You've earned it.
entries.fr: En tout cas, grâce à tes efforts, il ne reste plus qu'un adversaire à combattre dans le Deltastice. Prends le temps de te reposer, tu l'as bien mérité.
entries.ja:
体に不調はないか？　ちゃんと声は出るか？
おかげで、次は「デルタ」での最終決戦だ……
しっかりと休憩をとってから、再開するとしよう。
